    <meta name="calibre:rating" content="8.00"/>
    <dc:description><div>

<p class="MsoNormal" style="text-align:justify">Written by an intellectual Roman
emperor, the Meditations offer a wide range of spiritual reflections developed
as the leader struggled to understand himself and the universe. Marcus Aurelius
covers topics as diverse as the question of virtue, human rationality, the
nature of the gods, and his own emotions, spanning from doubt and despair to
conviction and exaltation.<p></p></p>

</div></dc:description>
